description: Red-black planning relaxes only some variables of a planning task. *Red* variables are delete-relaxed: once they reach a value, they keep it. *Black* variables keep their real behaviour and have one value at a time. The heuristic takes the `h_FF` relaxed plan and runs it under these rules; when a black variable has the wrong value, it inserts a cheapest path through that variable's domain transition graph (*plan repair*). The cost of the repaired plan is `h_RB`. With this default repair it is never below `h_FF`, equal to it when all variables are red, and not admissible. A `Painting` chooses the black variables; use it for satisficing search where `h_FF` ignores important deletes.
